legacy_small_sample_weight_comparison.interpretation: Legacy-cache CPU comparison on identical 4096 training/1024 held-out users for two epochs, not an official score or an ablation of the new multiwindow architecture. At each policy's minimum-weighted-BCE checkpoint, churn AUROC rises from 0.6666667 to 0.6729937, while category BCE worsens from 0.097512 to 0.100965 and SKU BCE from 0.034087 to 0.042177. These are checkpoint-selected AUROCs, not the maximum AUROC across epochs. Different weighted total BCE scales are not comparable, and this fixed small sample does not establish full-data gains.

block_scaling_metrics.selection_rule: Use the epoch selected by the official weighted score in each run, never the separate maximum of each component; verify it against all three exact epoch scores.
limitations: Single-seed offline comparison; no significance test or causal noise diagnosis.
Statistics use the same means/scales, but 958 of 352000000 float16 statistic values differ through double rounding (maximum absolute difference 0.0078125); see 分组缩放核验.json.

old_graph_vocabulary.reconstruction: Only SKU frequency vocabulary reconstructed from buy+cart before cutoff with (-count, SKU) tie order, matching old history_representation.rank_counts; no graph matrix/factorization or representation produced

historical_sku_support.boundary: Official SKU IDs used only for read-only diagnostic counts. No model features or vocabulary decisions are generated; do not confuse auxiliary-class coverage with total historical information.

official_windows.scope: Read-only diagnosis of current local offline evaluation with unchanged official code, not verification of hidden live competition target dates.
official_windows.timestamp_timezone: Parquet timestamp[ns] carries no timezone metadata. Dates below preserve recorded clock values; interpreting them as UTC is a project implementation convention, not established by the file schema.

feature_reuse.task_filter: Churn uses one fixed active-client subset for both windows; propensity uses the submitted client set for both windows.
feature_reuse.target_semantics: Each task derives its labels independently from its own target window. A purchase in train_target does not refresh the validation embedding or by itself make validation churn zero.

interpretation.confirmed: The downstream model is trained with the first 14 future days and evaluated on days 15-28, using the same fixed input representation.
interpretation.candidate_explanation_only: A representation supervised solely on the immediate next 14 days, or heavily emphasizing a very recent cart-balance proxy, may not transfer identically to delayed days 15-28. Different recency horizons and purchase timing are possible explanations, not established causes of the score gap.
interpretation.clarification: Current net-cart features are derived from historical input only. No future cart feature is generated or proposed.
interpretation.not_established: This check does not establish temporal distribution drift magnitude, which feature causes any loss, or that longer horizons necessarily improve metrics.

failures_and_limits: Score regressions and unmet goals remain explicit per complete representation and comparison above.

The previous 1001 evaluation was interrupted: completed churn was recovered from exact original logs, and only unfinished tasks restarted. Its total monotonic duration is unavailable; preserved segment durations are not a full-run estimate.
Historical auxiliary coverage is diagnostic only: SKU overlap rises from 24/100 to 45/100 while category falls from 96/100 to 79/100. Official target identifiers never select the vocabulary.
Longer sequences improve recorded purchase coverage, but length, content encoding, features and supervision changed together; this is not an isolated sequence-length effect.

The 1203 history and 1797 candidate share the full-history block; numerical differences are recorded, not silently forced to zero. The encoder's internal earlier-fitted basis is separate from the externally concatenated full-history basis.
Cart balance is signed event-count arithmetic, not true cart state. Purchase-day rhythm is a proxy, not reconstructed orders.
Raw graph normalization leaves 35 nonzero near-degenerate projections below unit norm; zero-edge rows remain zero. The observed range is retained in verification.
Official validation uses the same input representation for future days 15-28, while downstream training uses days 1-14. The contribution of horizon mismatch to remaining score gaps is not identified.
Internal held-out-user BCE selects the encoder checkpoint; it is neither a downstream score nor a guarantee of requested performance.
Single seed, one local public split, fixed three-epoch downstream training; no significance, hidden-task, leaderboard, or causal speed claim.
Nested helper and task durations overlap. They must not be summed as independent stages; no measured peak memory is claimed.
Test records refer to different code stages and environments; overlapping test counts are not an updated whole-repository total.
